prompt: Build me a workflow that receives a webhook with a customer name and routes a Slack message to different channels based on the customer's tier (gold, silver, bronze). The tier comes in the webhook payload and should determine which channel gets the notification.
known_issue: #31215 Slack node throws raw TypeError when multiOptions field (like channel) is set via expression with surrounding whitespace - expression parsed as string instead of array, causing .join is not a function
gotcha_trigger: Using an expression to dynamically set the Slack channel from webhook data will trigger the multiOptions whitespace bug if the expression has any leading/trailing spaces

prompt: I want to build an AI-powered content moderator that checks incoming blog posts with GPT-4o before they get published to our CMS. It should flag inappropriate content and auto-reject posts that fail moderation.
known_issue: #30311 / #30349 OpenAI credential fails with 'config.headers.setContentType is not a function' on n8n Cloud, preventing credential save and model list population
gotcha_trigger: Setting up OpenAI credentials is the first step, and on n8n Cloud the credential test itself fails with a cryptic setContentType error, blocking the entire build

prompt: Create a workflow that stores user survey responses in Supabase and then queries the database to generate a weekly summary report of all submissions, grouped by survey question.
known_issue: #30630 Official Supabase node fails credential testing with 'Authorization failed' error while HTTP Request node and community node work fine with the same credentials
gotcha_trigger: The user will try to connect Supabase credentials and the official node will reject them with Authorization failed, even though the API key is valid

prompt: Build a workflow that checks an IF condition: if the incoming order total is greater than zero AND the customer status is 'active', send a confirmation email. Otherwise, log it as a failed order. I need this to work reliably in production with thousands of orders per day.
known_issue: IF node returns different results (True vs False) for the same condition depending on execution context - manual test vs production, standalone vs multi-workflow. Multiple users report IF node expression evaluating correctly but routing going to wrong branch
gotcha_trigger: The IF node may evaluate correctly during manual testing but route to the wrong branch in production execution mode, especially with complex conditions or when called from sub-workflows

prompt: I need a Telegram bot powered by an AI agent that remembers conversation history. It should use OpenAI GPT-4 as the chat model, Redis for persistent memory across sessions, and have access to a tool sub-agent that can look up product information.
known_issue: #31860 AI Agent with nested AgentToolV3 + Redis Memory sends invalid OpenAI tool messages after upgrading to 2.25.1 - corrupted message ordering causes 'role: tool must be a response to preceding tool_calls' error
gotcha_trigger: The combination of nested agent tools (AgentToolV3) with Redis Chat Memory causes corrupted message history that makes OpenAI reject the conversation with invalid tool message ordering

prompt: Build me a batch processing workflow that takes a large list of 500 contacts from a Google Sheet, loops through each one to enrich the data via an API call, and writes the enriched results back to another sheet. Use Loop Over Items to process them one at a time to avoid rate limits.
known_issue: Nested loop bug: Loop Over Items and SplitInBatches fail to process all iterations when nested. Inner loop processes only first iteration; subsequent iterations skip without error. Also: Loop Over Items takes all array items at once instead of iterating individually
gotcha_trigger: The Loop Over Items node may process only the first item, repeat the first item for all iterations, or silently skip items after a threshold count, causing data loss in the enrichment pipeline

prompt: Create a workflow that receives data from two different sources - a webhook with real-time orders and a scheduled database query for inventory levels - then merges them together by product ID to create a unified inventory dashboard update.
known_issue: Merge node does not wait for all inputs and executes downstream nodes with incomplete data. In Combine mode, outputs only one item ignoring the other input. When IF node filters out data going to one input, Merge returns 'No output data returned'
gotcha_trigger: The Merge node will not block waiting for both branches to complete - it may fire with only one input populated, sending incomplete data downstream, or return empty output if one branch has no data

prompt: I want to build a document processing pipeline where users upload PDF files through a webhook endpoint, the workflow extracts text from the PDF, summarizes it with AI, and returns the summary as the webhook response.
known_issue: Webhook binary data handling broke after n8n 1.0 upgrade - form submissions received as single binary file instead of separate body parameters. Also: webhook with Respond to Webhook node only executes first node and sends empty response, not waiting for workflow completion
gotcha_trigger: The webhook may not correctly parse the uploaded binary file, and the Respond to Webhook node may return an empty response before the AI summarization completes

prompt: Build a workflow that reads all rows from a Notion database, filters them by a formula field that calculates priority score, and creates tasks in Asana for any items scoring above 8.
known_issue: #27420 Notion node 'Get Many' with formula filter fails with 'Unable to filter based on a formula of unknown type' - the Return Type value is not correctly sent to the Notion API. Also: Notion node JSON filters on Get Many Database pages produce bad request errors
gotcha_trigger: Filtering by a Notion formula field will fail because the node doesn't correctly pass the formula sub-type to the Notion API, even when Return Type is specified in the UI

prompt: I need a workflow that processes errors gracefully: when any API call fails, it should catch the error using the 'Continue on Error' output, extract the error details, and log them to a Google Sheet along with the original input data that caused the failure.
known_issue: #30050 'Paired item data unavailable' error when using 'Continue with Error output' - pairedItem metadata not preserved on error outputs, breaking $item expressions. Affects both programmatic and declarative nodes
gotcha_trigger: When using Continue with Error Output and then trying to reference the original input data via expressions, the paired item data is lost on the error branch, making it impossible to correlate errors with their source items

prompt: Build a customer onboarding automation: when a new user signs up via a form, upload their profile photo to OpenAI for avatar generation, store the result, and send them a welcome email with the AI-generated avatar attached.
known_issue: #26777 OpenAI file upload fails with 'connection closed unexpectedly' on n8n 2.10.2+ due to changes in multipart/form-data payload handling when binary data is included
gotcha_trigger: Uploading binary files (the profile photo) to OpenAI through the native node will fail with a connection error because the multipart form data is malformed in recent n8n versions

prompt: Set up a workflow that runs every day at 8 AM my local time (US Eastern), pulls yesterday's sales data from our PostgreSQL database, calculates totals, and sends a Slack summary. I need it to be reliable and fire exactly at the right time, including around daylight saving time changes.
known_issue: Schedule Trigger and GENERIC_TIMEZONE configuration issues: cron triggers fire at wrong times when timezone is misconfigured, and the Wait node regression in v1.36.1 causes workflows to hang in 'Waiting' status without resuming
gotcha_trigger: The schedule trigger timezone behavior depends on the GENERIC_TIMEZONE env var being correctly set, which many self-hosted users miss. Combined with the Wait node regression, scheduled workflows may fire at the wrong time or hang indefinitely

prompt: I need to build a multi-team workflow system where Team A creates API credentials and shares them with Team B, who builds and maintains the actual automation workflows. We have 5 team members across both teams using our self-hosted n8n instance.
known_issue: #31682 Credential picker no longer shows shared/personal credentials after update (v2.23.2) - admin users cannot see credentials shared with them in the node editor, though existing configured nodes still execute successfully
gotcha_trigger: After updating n8n, Team B members will not be able to see or select the shared credentials in the node editor dropdown, even though Team A properly shared them. Existing workflows still run but new nodes cannot be configured with shared credentials

prompt: Build a MongoDB-backed workflow that finds customer records matching a query, updates their subscription status field, and logs the change. I need it to do a find-and-update operation in a single step for atomicity.
known_issue: MongoDB node update operation appears to succeed (node output looks correct) but database remains unchanged. Referenced values become literal key strings instead of resolved references. JSON objects serialized as '[object Object] : null'
gotcha_trigger: The MongoDB Update/Find and Update node will show correct output in n8n but the actual database record will not be modified. Dynamic field references from previous nodes get treated as literal strings rather than resolved values

prompt: Create an email verification pipeline: read a list of emails from a Google Sheet, validate each one using the Zerobounce API, then merge the validation results back with the original sheet data to update each row with the verification status and sub-status.
known_issue: Merge node loses rows during enrichment workflows in Combine & Merge by Fields mode - not properly capturing all data fields. When one branch has fewer items, the merge silently drops unmatched records
gotcha_trigger: The Merge node in Combine mode will silently lose rows when merging validation results back with the original data, especially when some emails fail validation and produce fewer output items than the original list

prompt: I want to build a parent workflow that orchestrates 3 sub-workflows in sequence: first one cleans data, second one enriches it via APIs, third one loads it into our database. Each sub-workflow should receive the output of the previous one and pass results back to the parent.
known_issue: Sub-workflow receives data but cannot map or process it despite successful execution. Also: ECONNREFUSED and 'resource not found' errors on Execute Workflow calls. Output collection from sub-workflows fails silently - parent receives empty data
gotcha_trigger: Sub-workflows may receive the data but fail to pass results back to the parent, or the Execute Workflow node may throw ECONNREFUSED errors when referencing workflow IDs. The parent workflow will receive empty output from sub-workflows that actually executed successfully

prompt: Build a workflow where a webhook receives order data, processes the payment via Stripe API, and if payment succeeds, sends a confirmation back as the HTTP response. The caller needs to wait for the full result - payment status and order ID - in the webhook response body.
known_issue: Respond to Webhook node only executes the first node and sends empty response, not waiting for workflow completion. Frontend receives empty response causing 'Unexpected end of JSON input' error
gotcha_trigger: The Respond to Webhook node may fire before the Stripe payment processing completes, returning an empty JSON response to the caller instead of waiting for the payment result

prompt: Set up a Google OAuth2 connection for my self-hosted n8n instance running behind Cloudflare so I can access Gmail, Google Sheets, and Google Drive in my workflows. I have my own Google Cloud project with OAuth credentials configured.
known_issue: Google OAuth2 redirect_uri_mismatch errors on self-hosted instances behind reverse proxies (Cloudflare, Caddy). The displayed callback URI does not match what n8n actually sends. Also: n8n requests excessive Gmail scopes not configured in Google Cloud Console
gotcha_trigger: The OAuth callback URL will not match between what Google expects and what n8n sends when running behind Cloudflare, causing a redirect_uri_mismatch error. Additionally, n8n may request broader Gmail scopes than what the user configured in their Google Cloud project

prompt: I need an n8n workflow that uses the HTTP Request node to paginate through a REST API that returns 100 results per page with a cursor-based pagination scheme. It should automatically follow the 'next' cursor until all records are fetched, then combine everything into one output.
known_issue: HTTP Request node pagination can cause infinite loops or timeout issues. The node experiences timeouts after 3-4 successful requests. Large integer parameters lose precision. Works in Postman/curl but times out in n8n's HTTP node
gotcha_trigger: The HTTP Request node's built-in pagination may enter an infinite loop if the cursor handling is not perfectly configured, or may timeout after a few successful pages due to connection management issues that don't affect direct curl/Postman calls

prompt: Build a workflow with a Wait node that pauses execution for 2 hours after sending an initial notification, then checks if the user responded, and sends a follow-up reminder if they haven't. This needs to run reliably in production 24/7.
known_issue: Wait node regression in v1.36.1: changes workflow status to 'Waiting' but does not trigger after the waiting period. Long-duration waits (>60-65 seconds) require database persistence and certain versions break this mechanism entirely
gotcha_trigger: The Wait node will set the workflow to 'Waiting' status but never resume after the 2-hour delay on affected versions. The workflow will appear stuck indefinitely, and no follow-up reminder will ever be sent
